# Limitcode Pro

Limitcode Pro is a lightweight AI coding agent that lives inside Sublime Text.
It is built for developers who want an agentic workflow without moving to a
heavy AI IDE or adopting a terminal-first workflow. It works in a side-by-side
chat view: it can inspect project files, apply approved edits, run approved
commands, search the web, load skills, call MCP servers, and run focused
subagents - all under configurable permission rules. There is no separate
agent daemon for direct API providers: the plugin connects to the provider
from inside the editor.

The open-source edition is an AI pair programming assistant that works only on
the files you have open in the editor (read_file, write_to_file, edit_file).
The Pro edition is the fully autonomous version.

## Pricing

Limitcode Pro is a one-time purchase, activated on up to three devices.
The open-source edition is free. See [pricing.md](https://limitcode.jawuil.dev/pricing.md)
or email hola@jawuil.dev.
